newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers peak/off-peak power through Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers peak/off-peak power through Monday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer both peak and off-peak power for Saturday through Monday pre-schedulings, but slightly raised most offer prices, the agency said Friday.
BPA had resumed surplus power offers Thursday after refraining from surplus sales for the Tuesday through Thursday holiday period.
Sales during peak demand hours on Saturday and Monday were limited to 500 megawatts (MW), but no limits were placed on other offers.
Monday firm power during off-peak demand hours was offered at $10.25 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries, up slightly from $10.00 for Friday.
Firm power during peak demand hours was offered at $20.00 (Northwest) and $21.00 (COB), up from $18.75 and $19.75 respectively for Friday.
Monday non-firm power during light load hours was offered at $10.25 per MWh for all deliveries.
Peak non-firm power was offered at $18.75-21.00 (Northwest) and $20.00-22.50 (COB), compared with $19.00 and $20.00, respectively for Friday.
